page: Microsoft Azure EC64as_cc_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECACCV5 server family. Powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor with x86_64 architecture, it features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 32 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 3.525 GHz and includes 32 MB of L3 cache. The server is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory performance. The server achieves top-tier results in multi-core stress-ng tests and PassMark CPU evaluations. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient for cached operations, reaching 4138.93 GB/sec in small-block read tests. However, uncached large-block memory operations drop to average levels, with read speeds of 122.1 GB/sec and write speeds of 62.34 GB/sec. Cryptographic and compression tasks perform well, as evidenced by strong PassMark encryption scores and high multi-threaded bzip3 decompression throughput.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and strong database benchmark performance, this server is suited for memory-intensive workloads, database hosting, and multi-threaded data processing. While small-model LLM text generation is strong, large-model text generation is weak due to the lack of dedicated GPU acceleration. The hardware profile offers high resource density for memory-bound enterprise applications without the added cost of bundled local storage or accelerators.
